description: Incremental feed: returns items added after `after`, oldest first, plus a new cursor. Call again with that cursor to get only what is new.

after.description: The cursor returned by your previous sync_news call; 0 to start from the oldest retained item

category.description: Comma-separated IPTC top-level categories: arts-culture-entertainment, conflict-war, crime-law, disaster-accident, economy-business, education, environment, health, human-interest, labour, lifestyle-leisure, politics, religion, science-technology, society, sport, weather

country.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the publisher's country, e.g. "US,GB"

format.description: md: readable with summaries; lines: tab-separated, fewest tokens; ndjson/json: full records

kind.description: Comma-separated: article, press_release, official, community, research, sponsored

political.description: true: political stories only (political score ≥ 0.5); false: non-political only

since.description: Only items published at/after this: RFC 3339, a date, or an age like "6h", "2d"

source.description: Comma-separated source ids (see list_sources) or publisher domains

sponsored.description: Paid press releases are labeled; exclude to omit them

tone_min.description: Only items with tone ≥ this (-1 most negative … 1 most positive)

name: sync_news
title: Get new items since a cursor
